chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Mūsā ibn ʿUmar, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, concerning:
Regarding a man who is performing salat (prayer), he said: there should be before him a small heap of dust, or he should draw a line before himself.
ai.seo_question: What should be placed in front of a person performing salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction related to the one performing salat (prayer) and what should be placed or marked in front of him. It indicates establishing a visible boundary before the worshipper, such as a small heap of dust or a drawn line.
